generator: ios-native/tools/render-sprites.mjs (renders game/js/01…09 with three.js r170 in headless Chromium)

projection.type: orthographic 3/4 view, same yaw/pitch as the web camera (CAM_YAW 45°, CAM_PITCH 57°), no perspective
projection.worldAxes: world x, z on the deck (sim coordinates of the web game), y up. The camera sits at +x,+z looking toward -x,-z.
projection.screenFromWorld: u = (x - z) * 0.707107 * ppm ;  v = (y * 0.544639 - (x + z) * 0.707107 * 0.838671) * ppm   (u right, v up; ppm = 24 for SpriteKit points)
projection.depth: nearness = (x + z) * 0.385118 + y * 0.838671  (larger = closer to the camera = draw later / higher zPosition)
projection.directions: dir = Int((hd / (2π) * 16).rounded()) & 15 with hd = atan2(dx, dz) in WORLD space (the web game's heading / aim angle). dir 0 faces world +z (screen down-left), 4 faces +x (down-right), 8 faces -z (up-right), 12 faces -x (up-left); screen-up (the web FWD vector) is hd = 225° (dir 10)
projection.groundPlaneTextures: flat textures (decals, telegraph rings, lanes, glow pools, pad marks) are top-down: put the SKSpriteNode (zRotation = world rotation) inside a container node with yScale = 0.838671 (= sin pitch) and zRotation = 0; world rotation r about +y maps to zRotation = r. Size in points = metres * 24. Exact for an orthographic camera (x,z -> rotate 45°, squash y).
projection.recommendedCameraScale: the web game shows ~23 m across a portrait iPhone (≈17–18 pt/m): SKCameraNode.setScale(1.35) (≈18 pt/m) matches it; 1.0 is a closer view at native sprite resolution

lighting.rig: sprites are pre-lit with a bright "full light" rig: the game's moon direction (-25, 60, 35), cool sky dome, warm fill from the viewer (flashlights). ACES filmic, sRGB.
lighting.inGameDarkness: multiply by a light map: about [0.27, 0.31, 0.42] in the dark (moon + sky only), 1.0 inside flashlight cones / lamp pools, >1 not possible with multiply — add light pools additively instead
lighting.glowLayers: BugsGlow / MarinesGlow hold the emissive parts only (pink / acid / ember speckles, visors, lamps) with a soft halo, premultiplied: draw ABOVE the darkness with blendMode .add at the same position, anchor and scale (they are @2x-only images with the same point size as the lit frame)
lighting.bugBrightness: bug frames use instance brightness 1.15; the web game varies it per bug 0.55…1.3 → multiply color by 0.48…1.13 (colorBlendFactor 1, SKColor(white:))

atlasNotes: Sprite atlases live in Assets.xcassets/*.spriteatlas (Xcode packs them into pages per scale and trims transparent borders itself; SKTexture.size() keeps the untrimmed frame size, so the anchors below stay valid). Load with SKTextureAtlas(named: "Bugs").textureNamed("runner_walk_03_5"). Frame names are unique across atlases. Lit frames have @2x + @3x, glow frames @2x only.

level.cell: 1 m grid cell (web walk grid G = 128, world x / z in [-64, 64)); every floor / edge piece covers one cell or one cell edge
layers: background (Background atlas: haze, towers, motes) — fixed behind everything
under: support columns, girders, lift shaft, pipes, side skirts and stair walls — sort by nearness of the anchor
floor: floor / ramp / stair tiles and the lift deck — LOWER height tiers first, then nearness (tiles of one tier never overlap except by the 2 cm bleed)
floorDecal: stains (Ground decals, .multiply), hazard strips, vents, studs, snow drifts, glow pools (.add), telegraph rings
object: railings, posts, lamps, pillars, crates, beacon bases, lift rail / centre, corpses, bugs, marines, props — ONE layer sorted by nearness of the anchor (zPosition = nearness)
fx: particles, lasers, beams, glow layers (*Glow atlases, .add) above the darkness overlay
assembly: for every walkable cell (walk != 0): floor_{g|s}_p{phase}_c{corners} (or ramp_* / stair_* where the height field slopes; the lift disc is one lift_deck)

for every cell side that borders the abyss (walk == 0): a rail piece (+ rail_post every 2 m and at run ends, rail_corner_* at outer corners), and for s (+z) / e (+x) sides a side_* skirt (stair cells: wall_*)
hazard platforms: haz_x / haz_z along the railing edges; landing pad: Ground/pad_mark + stud_amber
supports under every platform rectangle; girders under platforms > 10 x 10 m; pipes on a few long sides
props from the level data (crates, pillars, vents, beacon bases, lamps every 12 m on runs ≥ 6 m)
level.testRender: tools/out/sheets/level_assembly.png (+ tools/previews/level_assembly.png) is assembled from these sprites by tools/lib/level.mjs (assembly()) with exactly the rules above — a reference implementation for the native builder

decals_mask.worldSize: decal size s (metres) = the full texture width; the web game: ichor s = bugScale * 1.0…1.5, frost s = bugScale * 0.8, acid 1.6…2.1, blast scorch r * 1.1 (mini r * 0.8), boomer scorch 2.6, napalm scorch r * 1.8
decals_mask.note: texDecals cells as white/grey masks (splat, streak toward +x, scorch, colourful corpse remains). The web game multiplies the floor by mix(1, texture * tint, alpha). Tint at runtime only approximately (SpriteKit colorBlendFactor); exact pre-tinted versions are in decals_tinted. Random rotation r about +y.

decals_tinted.note: exact web stain colours baked in: SKSpriteNode(blendMode: .multiply), no colour tint; zRotation = r - π/4 inside the ground container. Ichor uses splat or streak 50/50 (fxBugDeath); frozen kills leave decal_frost; acid globs decal_acid; blasts / boomers / napalm decal_burn. The web game keeps a ring buffer of Q.decals stains (500 / 1000 / 1500).

fire.note: kind-1 fire particles with the colour + alpha ramp baked: play frames 0…7 evenly over the particle life (no tint). fire_pyro: flamethrower (start (1, .78, .4), a .5, size 0.3 → 1.4…2.1 m, life 0.42…0.58 s, speed 11…15 m/s); fire_blast: explosion / napalm cores (start (1, .55, .2), a .45); fireball: the alpha-blended billowing fireball body (start (1, .42, .12), a .85, size 1.0…1.6 → 2.2…3.4 m).

floor_grating.note: 1 x 1 m steel grating (open decks, catwalks, the lift) cell, 2 cm bleed so neighbours overlap without seams. Anchor = cell centre on the deck. phase = (i & 1) + 2 * (j & 1) with i = floor(x), j = floor(z) (keeps the 2 m texture continuous). corners = snow at the 4 cell corners (bit 1 = NW (-x,-z) corner snowy, 2 = NE (+x,-z), 4 = SW (-x,+z), 8 = SE (+x,+z)): sample a snow mask at the grid VERTICES (the web buildSnowMask: value noise + more snow within ~3 m of railings / props + slab bonus) and threshold at 0.5 — neighbouring tiles then always agree along their shared edge.

floor_slab.note: 1 x 1 m snow-crusted concrete slab (landing pad, stairs) cell, 2 cm bleed so neighbours overlap without seams. Anchor = cell centre on the deck. phase = (i & 1) + 2 * (j & 1) with i = floor(x), j = floor(z) (keeps the 2 m texture continuous). corners = snow at the 4 cell corners (bit 1 = NW (-x,-z) corner snowy, 2 = NE (+x,-z), 4 = SW (-x,+z), 8 = SE (+x,+z)): sample a snow mask at the grid VERTICES (the web buildSnowMask: value noise + more snow within ~3 m of railings / props + slab bonus) and threshold at 0.5 — neighbouring tiles then always agree along their shared edge.

lamps.note: lamp post standing on a railing line, the arm reaching 0.8 m toward `inward` (n = -z …): a lamp on a S edge points n. Web: every 12 m along runs ≥ 6 m, every third one green. Add a ground glow pool (Ground/glow, 3 m, lamp colour x0.3, additive) 1.5 m inward.

lasers.note: laser sights (setRibbon x2: glow 0.44 m wide at colour x0.5 + core 0.11 m at colour x3), colours baked, rendered through the web laserMat. Uniform along x: stretch xScale to the sight length (the web dash texture samples .r of a white canvas, so the shipped web lasers are solid too). Fade the far end to 15 % when nothing is hit (an alpha gradient or a second, fading sprite), 1.6x brighter while firing. laser_turret: 0.06 m wide green turret sight (pixelSize 64 x 8).

lift_rail.note: lift ring railing in 12 arcs of 30° (the opening toward +z, where the stairs arrive, is left out of segments 02 / 03); place each at lift centre + anchorsFromLiftCentre (metres, x / z) and depth-sort it like any object

lift_shaft.note: shaft collar under the lift rim (3 m band, r 10.6) with 16 teal lights; anchor = lift centre on the deck. Add support_0 columns at 8 points on a 10.9 m circle (deck - 0.5 m).

particles.note: white, tinted at runtime. p_soft_* = the additive PA sprite (fire, sparks, frost, glows; noise-ragged edge, a²), p_puff_* = the alpha PN sprite (smoke, steam, ichor droplets, debris). Sprite size = the emit() size in metres (diameter) * 24 pt, interpolated s0 → s1 over the life. Colour = the emit() colour converted with manifest.colour (ACES + sRGB); alpha ramps: kind 0 a*(1-t), kind 1 fire (see fire frames), kind 2 smoke a*min(1, 6t)*(1-t), kind 3 spark a*(1-t)^2. p_streak: velocity-aligned spark (head +x). p_flash: muzzle flash. p_shard: frost shatter splinters. p_chunk: chitin chips. p_snow: snowflake (0.025…0.065 m). p_mist: drifting mist banks (6…12 m, colour (0.62,0.72,0.84), alpha ≈ 0.1).

colour.note: web colours are linear HDR values pushed through ACES filmic + sRGB. display(c) below = that conversion (tools/lib/tonemap.mjs); use it for particle / light tints. Hex constants in the web code (0xRRGGBB) are sRGB already: linear = srgbToLinear(hex).
